title: Admitted tiered RossFast versus Reference production characterization

f_ross23_static_baseline.purpose: descriptive historical static baseline only; not a same-run comparator

purpose: Systematically characterize the canonically admitted K2->K4->K8 RossFast production solver against the Reference Richards solver, separating scientific/robustness behavior from shared-host performance screening.
measurement_first_rule: Persist this contract before timing or interpretation. No solver, Reference, tolerance, certificate or selection changes are permitted inside F-ROSS24.

domain.family: same fixed-flux E0 construction used by F-ROSS23 and the F-ROSS22 all-material production matrix
domain.exact_pairing: Reference and RossFast receive identical initial state, parameters, forcing, lower boundary and interval

K4.meaning: K2 rejected, K4 recomputed from original base state

K8.meaning: K2 and K4 rejected, K8 recomputed from original base state

science_metrics: RossFast temporal certificate and final tier/work count
head infinity/RMS difference on paired-valid cases
theta infinity/RMS difference on paired-valid cases
historical P2E10 threshold classification as descriptive diagnostic only

performance_contract.cpu_affinity: pin child process to one visible CPU
performance_contract.primary_metric: Fortran CPU_TIME accumulated per paired-valid case
performance_contract.formal_host_boundary: GitHub-hosted timing is screening only; formal production performance claim requires MP-admitted isolated host

analysis_questions: Does admitted tiered RossFast remain route-valid across all 216 E0 cases?
Where Reference Richards does not converge, does tiered RossFast remain valid?
On paired-valid cases, where is tiered RossFast faster, slower or unresolved relative to Reference?
How does speed depend on final K2/K4/K8 tier, material, saturation and forcing?
How much of the static F-ROSS23 performance deficit has been removed descriptively by the admitted cache+tiered production evolution?
Are any observed direct-state discrepancy patterns concentrated near high saturation?
reused_evidence: F-ROSS22 canonical admission and 216/216 production qualification
next_permitted_action: MEASURE: implement only a diagnostic/timing harness for the frozen admitted F-ROSS22 postimage, then execute the preregistered 216-case shared-host screening and regime analysis.
